nodes.one_liner_zh: 把一段文字变成 768 个数字
nodes.one_liner_en: Text becomes 768 numbers carrying meaning
nodes.professional_zh: 嵌入把任意一段文本映射为一个 768 维浮点向量（embeddinggemma-2，MEAN 池化，归一化）。训练目标是「含义相近 ⇒ 向量夹角小」，于是几何关系成了含义的代理。检索时查询与文档各算一个向量，比较就变成比夹角。
nodes.professional_en: An embedding maps any text to a 768-dim float vector (embeddinggemma-2, MEAN pooling, normalized). Training pulls semantically close texts toward nearby points, so geometry becomes a proxy for meaning. Search embeds the query and every document once, then compares angles.
nodes.plain_zh: 想象一张巨大的地图，每个意思都有一个坐标——坐标不是两个数，是 768 个数。意思越接近的两段话，坐标离得越近：「猫」和「狗」挨着，「猫」和「资产负债表」隔得很远。电脑不认识字，但它特别擅长算坐标之间的远近。
nodes.plain_en: Picture a giant map where every idea has a coordinate — made not of two numbers but of 768. Texts with similar meaning land close together: 'cat' and 'dog' sit near each other; 'cat' and 'balance sheet' are far apart. Computers don't understand words, but they are superb at measuring distance.
nodes.example_zh: 查询「怎么给长书的分页做索引」能命中讲「长文件续读」的段落——两个短语一个词都不重合，但向量方向接近。亲手验证嵌入没被改坏：GOLDMINE_LIVE=1 python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_reference_vectors.py tests/test_reference_media_vectors.py → 应见 2 passed, 2 skipped（逐位相同）。
nodes.example_en: The query 'how to index pagination for long books' hits a section about 'resuming long files' — zero shared words, nearby vectors. Verify the embedder yourself: GOLDMINE_LIVE=1 python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_reference_vectors.py tests/test_reference_media_vectors.py → expect '2 passed, 2 skipped' (bit-exact).

nodes.one_liner_zh: 只看方向不看长度的夹角
nodes.one_liner_en: Vector angle; length ignored
nodes.professional_zh: 两个向量夹角的余弦，等于点积除以模长之积（本项目向量已归一化，点积即余弦）。值域 [0,1]，1 = 方向完全一致。选它而非欧氏距离：文本长短只改变向量长度（幅度），方向才编码含义。
nodes.professional_en: The cosine of the angle between two vectors — dot product over length product (vectors here are normalized, so the dot product is the cosine). Range [0,1]; 1 means identical direction. Chosen over Euclidean distance because text length only changes vector magnitude; direction encodes meaning.
nodes.plain_zh: 两支手电筒从同一点照出去：照向同一个东西，光柱方向几乎重合；照向不同的东西，光柱张开一个角。余弦就是量这个张角——零度得满分 1，九十度得 0。光柱本身多长（文章多长）不重要。
nodes.plain_en: Two flashlights beam from the same spot: aimed at the same object the beams nearly overlap; aimed at different objects they spread apart. Cosine measures that spread — 0 degrees scores 1, 90 degrees scores 0. How long each beam is (how long each text is) doesn't matter.
nodes.example_zh: z 分数手算锚点的起点：26 个向量行，1 个目标行余弦 = 1、其余 25 行 = 0（见 z-score 条目，最终 z = √(26−1) = 5）。goldmine search 加 --why 会把每个命中的余弦与 z 分解打印出来，每个数字可追问来源。
nodes.example_en: The anchor for the z-score hand computation: 26 vector rows, one target with cosine 1 and 25 filler rows at 0 (see z-score: the final z = √(26−1) = 5). Run goldmine search with --why to see the cosine and z breakdown printed for every hit.

nodes.one_liner_zh: 这个分数今天有多出众
nodes.one_liner_en: How outstanding this score is today
nodes.professional_zh: z = (单个余弦 − 均值) / 标准差。原始余弦没有绝对意义——同一模型对不同查询的分数分布完全不同（A 查询全体 0.8，B 查询全体 0.3），标准化后「出众程度」才可跨查询、跨模态比较。本项目均值按模态分组、标准差用全库统一（见分模态均值）。准入门槛建在 z 上而非余弦上，正因为 z 随库大小自适应。
nodes.professional_en: z = (one cosine − mean) / standard deviation. A raw cosine has no absolute meaning — the same model may score a whole query's results around 0.8 and another's around 0.3 — so standardization is what makes 'how outstanding' comparable across queries and modalities. Means are grouped per modality while the std is global (see per-modality mean). The admission threshold sits on z, not cosine, precisely because z adapts to corpus size.
nodes.plain_zh: 考试 90 分算高吗？要看全班的平均分和分数波动。平均 85、波动 2 分，你的 90 就非常突出；平均 89、波动 5 分，90 分平平无奇。z 分数就是「你比平均分高出几个波动单位」。
nodes.plain_en: Is 90 on a test a good score? It depends on the class average and the spread. Average 85 with a spread of 2 — your 90 is remarkable. Average 89 with a spread of 5 — your 90 is nothing special. The z-score counts how many 'spread units' you stand above the average.
nodes.example_zh: 手算（测试里钉死）：26 个向量行，1 个目标行余弦 = 1、25 个填充行 = 0。均值 = 1/26，目标偏离 = 25/26，全局 std = 5/26。z = (25/26)/(5/26) = 5 = √(26−1)。通用规律：一行鹤立鸡群时 z ≈ √(n−1)——库越大，同样的领先换来越大的 z。
nodes.example_en: Hand computation (pinned in tests): 26 vector rows, one target with cosine 1, 25 fillers at 0. Mean = 1/26, deviation = 25/26, global std = 5/26. z = (25/26)/(5/26) = 5 = √(26−1). General rule: one standout row gives z ≈ √(n−1) — the bigger the library, the bigger the z for the same lead.

dig_deeper.why_zh: 被标准化的原料是什么
dig_deeper.why_en: What raw material is being standardized

nodes.one_liner_zh: 文本图片音频各算各的平均分
nodes.one_liner_en: Each modality gets its own mean
nodes.professional_zh: z 分数的均值按模态分组计算（文本一组、图片一组、音频一组……），但标准差用全库统一。这是被 DigUp 实测教育出的折中：全按模态分组会让窄组（如 PDF 页）被吹爆——同组一个高分除以极小的组内 std，z 虚高，实测 91→94/105 变差，于是退回全局 std。新增模态组行数 <20 时均值不稳，是维护者要盯的点。
nodes.professional_en: The z-score mean is computed per modality group (text, images, audio, …) while the standard deviation stays global. This compromise was taught by DigUp's measurements: fully per-modality grouping lets narrow groups (like PDF pages) blow up — one high score divided by a tiny within-group std inflates z — and measurably made results worse (91→94 out of 105), so the global std came back. Modality groups under 20 rows have unstable means; maintainers watch for that.
nodes.plain_zh: 班级平均分怎么算才公平？把体育特长班和普通班混在一起算一个平均，普通班全显得很差。所以平均分分班算，各班跟各班的均值比；但「分数波动的幅度」用全校同一把尺——尺子也分班的话，小班随便一次起伏都被放大成惊天动地。
nodes.plain_en: How should class averages be computed fairly? Mix the athletes' class with the regular class into one average and everyone in the regular class looks bad. So averages are per class — but the 'spread ruler' is school-wide. If the ruler were per class too, any tiny wobble in a small class would look like an earthquake.
nodes.example_zh: 一次搜索里文本行均值 0.42、图片行均值 0.31：同一个余弦 0.40 在图片里「高于平均」，在文本里「低于平均」，z 的符号因此不同。DigUp 全按模态分组的实测代价：91→94/105（变差），先例记在 search.py 头注释里。
nodes.example_en: In one search the text rows average 0.42 while image rows average 0.31: the same cosine 0.40 is above average among images but below average among text, flipping the sign of z. DigUp's measured cost of fully per-modality grouping: 91→94 out of 105 — worse. The precedent lives in the search.py header notes.

nodes.one_liner_zh: 数据库式精确找词，越稀有越值钱
nodes.one_liner_en: Exact word lookup; rare words weigh more
nodes.professional_zh: FTS5 是 SQLite 内置的全文索引，本质是倒排索引：词 → 含它的行，像书后的索引页。BM25 是它的排名公式——查询词越稀有、在文档中出现越密、文档越短，排名越靠前。本项目只用 BM25 的排名（词法臂），从不把它的分值加进最终分数：BM25 低 = 好，方向与最终分数相反。
nodes.professional_en: FTS5 is SQLite's built-in full-text index — an inverted index mapping each word to the rows containing it, like a book's index pages. BM25 is its ranking formula: rarer query words, denser occurrences, and shorter documents rank higher. This project uses BM25's ranking only (the lexical arm); its raw score is never added to the final score — BM25 is lower-is-better, the opposite direction.
nodes.plain_zh: 一本书后面的索引页：「关键词 → 第几页」。翻索引比翻全书快得多。BM25 是给命中结果排队的规矩：命中一个全书只有三处提到的生僻词，比命中满篇都是的「的」值钱得多。
nodes.plain_en: The index pages at the back of a book: 'keyword → page numbers'. Flipping the index beats reading the whole book. BM25 is the queuing rule for hits: matching a word that appears three times in the whole book is worth far more than matching one that's on every page.
nodes.example_zh: 查 TRX50（主板编号）：语义模型不认识这个编号，只有 FTS5 能精确命中。跑 python3 -m goldmine search TRX50 --db evals/eval.sqlite；--why 输出里能看到 BM25 排名，但它只决定词法臂的顺序，对最终分数的贡献是 0。
nodes.example_en: Search 'TRX50' (a motherboard model number): the semantic model doesn't know the number — only FTS5 hits it exactly. Run python3 -m goldmine search TRX50 --db evals/eval.sqlite; --why shows the BM25 rank, but it only orders the lexical arm and contributes exactly 0 to the final score.

nodes.one_liner_zh: 语义分加词证分，词证更重
nodes.one_liner_en: Semantic plus heavier word-evidence score
nodes.professional_zh: score = 1.0·max(z,0) + 2.0·coverage^1.5（+ 类型命中加 1.0，平坦封顶不叠）。词证权重刻意更重；查询含「字母数字混合带数字」或 ≥4 位纯数字（发票号、工单号）时反转为 (0.5, 4.0)，词法压倒。为什么混合：两条臂各有盲区——纯语义抓不住精确编号，纯词法抓不住同义改写。DigUp 自己的数据里 RRF 融合输给加法融合，故不用 RRF。
nodes.professional_en: score = 1.0·max(z,0) + 2.0·coverage^1.5 (+1.0 for a kind match, flat and capped). Word evidence is deliberately heavier; queries containing alphanumeric-with-digit tokens or plain numbers of 4+ digits (invoice or ticket numbers) flip the weights to (0.5, 4.0) so lexical dominates. Why fuse at all: each arm is blind where the other sees — pure semantics misses exact model numbers, pure lexical misses paraphrases. DigUp's own data showed RRF losing to additive fusion, so RRF is out.
nodes.plain_zh: 断案同时听两个证人：一个懂「意思」，一个记性好、认得每个编号。平时更信记性好的那个；问到一串编号时，干脆几乎全听他的。
nodes.plain_en: A case heard by two witnesses: one understands 'meaning', the other has a photographic memory for exact numbers. Normally the memory witness weighs more; ask about a serial number and the verdict is almost entirely theirs.
nodes.example_zh: 常态权重 (w_m, w_c) = (1.0, 2.0)；查询含 TRX50 或 1234567 这类编号时自动翻转为 (0.5, 4.0)。goldmine search TRX50 --why 逐项打印每个命中的 z、coverage 与最终 score 分解。
nodes.example_en: Normal weights (w_m, w_c) = (1.0, 2.0); a query containing 'TRX50' or '1234567' flips them to (0.5, 4.0). goldmine search TRX50 --why prints the z, coverage and final score breakdown for every hit.

nodes.professional_zh: 候选池的唯一硬规则：z ≥ 3.0（z_gate）；词覆盖率 ≥ 0.5 的文件也进。3.0 由 v2.1 校准 A/B 定下（n=146 真模型评测）：从 2.0 提到 3.0，s@5 0.747→0.781、MRR 0.646→0.665、零命中诚实度 0.4→0.6，train 与 holdout 一致、零单题回归。扫描中 3.5 更好（0.822）但故意不采纳——一次扫描、过拟合风险，记录在案（「不做质量重试」纪律的来源）。
nodes.professional_en: The one hard rule into the candidate pool: z ≥ 3.0 (z_gate); files with word coverage ≥ 0.5 also enter. The 3.0 came from a v2.1 calibration A/B (n=146, real-model eval): raising 2.0→3.0 moved s@5 0.747→0.781, MRR 0.646→0.665, zero-hit honesty 0.4→0.6, consistent across train and holdout with zero per-query regressions. Scanning found 3.5 even better (0.822) — deliberately not adopted: one scan, overfitting risk, on the record. This is where the 'no quality retries' discipline comes from.
nodes.plain_zh: 海选。不是所有自称「有点像」的文件都能进下一轮：要么语义上真的鹤立鸡群，要么查询词真的出现在它身上。门槛是拿 146 道真题做 A/B 试验定下来的，不是拍脑袋。曾看到 3.5 更好看，但只试了一次不敢信，忍住没改。
nodes.plain_en: Auditions. Not every file claiming 'kind of similar' gets to the next round: either it stands clearly above the crowd semantically, or the query words actually appear in it. The bar was set by an A/B test on 146 real questions, not by gut. A higher bar of 3.5 looked better once — one try, not trusted, left alone.

nodes.professional_zh: search.v7 规则：混合模式查询下，一个文件若 z 分够高但没有任何词法证据（无 BM25 排名、coverage 为 0），不准进候选池。防的是语义模型的「空吸」——embedding 对某些查询天然亲近某些内容。例外：纯媒体文件（只有图片/音频向量、没有文字可沾）豁免——它们没资格提供见证，不能因此被判死刑。新增媒体段型时 _files_with_text 的口径要跟着审。
nodes.professional_en: The search.v7 rule: under a hybrid-mode query, a file with a high z but zero lexical evidence (no BM25 rank, coverage 0) may not enter the pool. It guards against semantic 'vacuum suction' — embeddings are naturally chummy between certain queries and certain content. Exception: pure media files (only image/audio vectors, no text to match) are exempt — they cannot bear witnesses, so they cannot be condemned for lacking one. When a new media segment type appears, _files_with_text's definition must be re-audited.

nodes.professional_en: A transformer emits one 768-dim vector per token position; pooling merges them into a single vector — MEAN (average) here. One vector per text is what makes indexing possible. The pooling mode is a canonical fingerprint field: switching MEAN/CLS/LAST switches vector families, and the fingerprint gate refuses the old library.

nodes.plain_en: Every paragraph of an essay gets its own score, but the index has room for only one — so take the average. How you merge is part of the dialect: change the merging rule and every vector changes flavor; everything must be recomputed.

nodes.one_liner_zh: 权重压成 8 位整数，小一半快数倍
nodes.one_liner_en: Weights squeezed to 8-bit integers
nodes.professional_zh: 神经网络权重本是 16 位浮点；量化把它们压成 8 位整数（Q8_0 是 llama.cpp 的 8 位格式，_0 表示对称分组，组内共享缩放因子摊薄误差）。模型文件约 1.5GB → 约 800MB，推理快数倍，精度损失极小。更激进的 Q4 精度损失开始可测；F16 被明确禁止——同模型家族实测激活值溢出 float16，记录在案。
nodes.professional_en: Neural weights are natively 16-bit floats; quantization packs them into 8-bit integers (Q8_0 is llama.cpp's 8-bit scheme; _0 means symmetric blocks sharing one scale factor to spread out error). The model file drops from ~1.5GB to ~800MB, inference gets several times faster, and accuracy barely moves. More aggressive Q4 starts measurably losing accuracy; F16 is explicitly banned — measured activation overflow in this model family, on the record.
nodes.plain_zh: 把一本用超大字号印的书换成紧凑排版：内容几乎一字不丢，纸省一半、翻起来更快。数字本来就没用到那么高的精度，砍掉尾巴不伤内容。但也不能砍太狠——再砍一档（Q4）就开始真丢内容了。
nodes.plain_en: Reprint a book in large font as a compact edition: barely a word lost, half the paper, much faster to flip through. The numbers never used that much precision, so trimming the tail costs nothing. But don't overdo it — one notch tighter (Q4) and content really starts to leak.

nodes.professional_en: llama.cpp is an LLM inference engine in pure C/C++ — no Python dependency, a single executable; llama-server is its bundled HTTP server. This project vendors it (source in-repo) pinned at b11461. nodes.one_liner_zh: 把图片音频搬进文本的向量空间
nodes.one_liner_en: Projects images and audio into text's vector space
nodes.professional_zh: embeddinggemma 是文本模型，看不见图片；mmproj 是配套投影头，把图片/音频编码器的输出投影进文本向量同一个 768 维空间——「一张猫的照片」从此能和「猫」这个词比夹角。这是多模态搜索的全部秘密：一切都被搬到同一空间。mmproj 文件的 sha256 进指纹（媒体四件套之一），且只在 helper 与 mmproj 都能解析时才附加——纯文本安装的指纹逐字节不变。
nodes.professional_en: embeddinggemma is a text model and cannot see images; mmproj is the companion projection head that maps image/audio encoder outputs into the same 768-dim space as text vectors — 'a photo of a cat' can now be angled against the word 'cat'. That is the entire secret of multimodal search: everything is moved into one space. The mmproj file's sha256 enters the fingerprint (one of the media four), attached only when both helper and mmproj resolve — a text-only install keeps a byte-identical fingerprint.
nodes.plain_zh: 要比较就得说同一种「坐标语言」。图片和声音本来各有各的方言，mmproj 是翻译官，把它们统统翻译到文字用的那套坐标系里。翻译官换人（模型文件变），所有翻译结果都要重来。
nodes.plain_en: You can only compare things speaking the same coordinate language. Images and sound each have their own dialect; mmproj is the interpreter who translates both into the coordinate system words use. Replace the interpreter (a different model file) and every translation must be redone.
nodes.example_zh: mmproj-embeddinggemma-2-Q8_0：装了它的机器指纹里多出 media、mmproj_sha256 等四个键，纯文本机器指纹逐字节不变。指纹拒现场：python3 -m goldmine search "copper gasket" --db evals/eval.sqlite.pre-p2b.sqlite; echo rc=$? → differs in: media，rc=3。

nodes.one_liner_zh: 旁边挂一个 C 写的媒体嵌入助手
nodes.one_liner_en: A C helper child process for media embeddings
nodes.professional_zh: llama-server 的 HTTP 接口不暴露 mtmd（多模态）嵌入——图片/音频进不了它。于是自写 1412 行纯 C11 的 goldmine-embed，静态链接 llama.cpp + mtmd 七个静态库，作为常驻边车与主程序同生共死。协议简单到不会错：每行一个 JSON（请求带 path_b64/wav_b64，回一个 768 维向量）。模型加载要搬约 1GB 进内存，常驻省的是加载与逐次 spawn，不是缓存计算图——gemma-embedding2 没有 KV 记忆，批次间只能清空重来。清理纪律：close() 按 pid 只杀自己 spawn 的子进程。
nodes.professional_en: llama-server's HTTP surface does not expose mtmd (multimodal) embeddings — images and audio can't get in. So the project wrote goldmine-embed, 1412 lines of pure C11 statically linking llama.cpp + mtmd (seven static libs), as a resident sidecar living and dying with the parent. The protocol is too simple to get wrong: one JSON per line (request carries path_b64/wav_b64, response is one 768-dim vector). Model loading moves ~1GB into memory, so residency saves the load and the per-call spawn — not a cached compute graph: gemma-embedding2 has no KV memory and batches restart clean. Cleanup discipline: close() kills only children it spawned itself, by pid.
nodes.plain_zh: 主程序旁边挂一辆挎斗摩托：主车管文字，挎斗管图片和声音。挎斗一次造好、随叫随到，不用每送一单重新发动。俩车说话的规矩简单到极点——一次递一张纸条，纸条上只写一行字。
nodes.plain_en: A sidecar motorcycle hitched to the main bike: the bike handles text, the sidecar handles images and sound. Built once, on call always — no restarting the engine for every delivery. Their communication is as simple as it gets: pass one note at a time, one line per note.

nodes.one_liner_zh: 单文件数据库；一文件一事务
nodes.one_liner_en: One-file database; one transaction per file
nodes.professional_zh: SQLite 是单文件数据库——整个索引就是一个 .sqlite 文件。WAL（预写日志）模式让读写不互相阻塞。事务 = 一组操作要么全成要么全不做；本项目一个文件一个事务：崩溃最坏丢这一个文件的这一次，绝不留半个文件的段。Ctrl-C = 退出码 130，重跑靠内容哈希跳过未变文件续传。
nodes.professional_en: SQLite is a single-file database — the whole index is one .sqlite file. WAL (write-ahead logging) lets readers and writers not block each other. A transaction is all-or-nothing; this project commits one transaction per file: a crash at worst loses that one file's current pass and never leaves half a file's segments behind. Ctrl-C exits 130; a rerun resumes because content-hash skipping spares unchanged files.
nodes.plain_zh: 整个图书馆的目录卡片装在一个抽屉里，搬家只需端走一个抽屉。WAL 是「先在便签上记一笔、稍后正式誊写」的记账法——有人查账时不必等誊写完。每个文件的登记要么整张卡写完、要么整张作废，绝不留半张。
nodes.plain_en: The whole library catalog lives in one drawer — moving house means carrying one drawer. WAL is bookkeeping on sticky notes first, formal ledger later — nobody reading the ledger waits for the scribe. Each file's registration is one whole card or nothing; half-written cards don't exist.
nodes.example_zh: 库目录下能看到 eval.sqlite-wal / -shm 伴生文件（WAL 模式的痕迹）。就算此刻断电，最坏损失 = 正在写的那个文件本次摄取；重跑摄取时内容 sha256 未变的文件直接跳过，几乎零成本。
nodes.example_en: You can see eval.sqlite-wal / -shm companions next to the database — WAL mode's footprints. Cut power right now and the worst loss is the one file being written this pass; rerun ingest and every file whose sha256 hasn't changed is skipped at near-zero cost.

nodes.one_liner_zh: 数据变一位，指纹面目全非
nodes.one_liner_en: Change one bit, the hash changes completely
nodes.professional_zh: SHA-256 把任意数据映射为 64 位十六进制摘要；输入变一位，输出面目全非（雪崩效应）。本项目的三处用途：摄取前比对文件内容是否变化（未变则跳过，G10 语义）；给模型文件验明正身（model_sha256、mmproj_sha256 进指纹）；作为指纹身份的哈希原料。
nodes.professional_en: SHA-256 maps any data to a 64-hex-digit digest; flip one input bit and the output is unrecognizable (avalanche effect). Three uses here: comparing file content before extraction (unchanged means skipped — the G10 semantics); verifying model files (model_sha256 and mmproj_sha256 go into the fingerprint); and serving as the hashing ingredient of fingerprint identity itself.
nodes.plain_zh: 给文件拍一张「指纹照」：哪怕只多了一个逗号，照片就完全认不出来。所以「照片没变」基本等于「文件没变」——重跑摄取时一眼判断哪些文件不用再看第二遍。
nodes.plain_en: Photograph a file's fingertips: add one comma and the photo is unrecognizable. 'Photo unchanged' therefore means 'file unchanged' — a rerun can tell at a glance which files never need a second look.
nodes.example_zh: 每波摄取先算候选文件 sha256，与库里存的内容哈希一致且版本新鲜 → 跳过——这就是「Ctrl-C 安全、重跑续传」。看嵌入身份：python3 -m goldmine status --db evals/eval.sqlite --json 里的 current.embed_id 即由这些 sha 派生。
nodes.example_en: Each wave hashes candidates first; a matching stored hash with fresh versions means skip — that's 'Ctrl-C safe, rerun resumes'. See identity at work: in python3 -m goldmine status --db evals/eval.sqlite --json, current.embed_id is derived from exactly these shas.

nodes.one_liner_zh: 一切决定向量取值的东西打包成哈希
nodes.one_liner_en: Everything that decides vector values, hashed
nodes.professional_zh: 一切「决定向量取值」的东西——模型身份、维度、提示词、池化、归一化、媒体加工串、预算——打包成 JSON，canonical 化后取 sha256 前 16 位。任何一项变 → 指纹变 → 旧库被门拒绝 exit 3。动机：两种指纹的向量混在一个库里互比分数 = 搜索静默变坏且无从察觉——这是「向量家族不混」的执法机制，也是四层身份模型（指纹/embed_id/提取器注册表/评测基线）的第一层。词法检索不过这道门，--lexical 永远可用。
nodes.professional_en: Everything that decides vector values — model identity, dimension, prompts, pooling, normalization, media preprocessing strings, budgets — is packed into JSON, canonicalized, and sha256-hashed to 16 hex chars. Any change flips the fingerprint and the gate refuses the old library with exit 3. Rationale: vectors from two fingerprints compared in one library silently corrupt search with no way to notice — this is how 'vector families never mix' is enforced. It is layer 1 of the four-layer identity model (fingerprint / embed_id / extractor registry / eval baseline). Lexical search skips this gate; --lexical is always available.
nodes.plain_zh: 菜品的配方指纹：原料、火候、厨具全部记下来盖个章。换任何一样，章就变了，老批次必须全部下架——新做法的菜和老批次摆在一起比味道，比试已经不公平了。
nodes.plain_en: A dish's recipe seal: ingredients, heat, cookware — all recorded and stamped. Change anything and the stamp changes; the old batch comes off the shelf. Comparing new-method dishes against old-batch dishes is a rigged taste test.

nodes.one_liner_zh: 键排序去空白，键序不同不算不同
nodes.one_liner_en: Sort keys, strip spaces; order stops mattering
nodes.professional_zh: 把 JSON 的键递归排序、去掉无关空白后序列化为确定字节串再哈希。这样 {"a":1,"b":2} 与 {"b":2,"a":1} 得到同一身份——语义相同的配置不该因为序列化顺序的巧合而分裂向量家族。tests/test_fingerprints.py 的 test_id_stable_across_key_order 钉死这条性质。
nodes.professional_en: Keys are recursively sorted and insignificant whitespace stripped, producing deterministic bytes to hash. {"a":1,"b":2} and {"b":2,"a":1} then share one identity — semantically identical configs must not split into two vector families by serialization accident. tests/test_fingerprints.py's test_id_stable_across_key_order pins this property.
nodes.plain_zh: 两张购物清单，一张按拼音排、一张随手写，买的东西一模一样就该算同一张单子。先统一按字母排序再比对，顺序就再也搅不了局。
nodes.plain_en: Two shopping lists — one alphabetized, one scribbled — buying exactly the same things should count as the same list. Sort both alphabetically before comparing, and order can never cause trouble again.
nodes.example_zh: goldmine/fingerprints.py 的 canonical()：keys=sorted + 无空白 separators，产出字节串供 sha256。测试 test_id_stable_across_key_order 明确验证键序不同 → 指纹相同。

nodes.one_liner_zh: 只收真正决定存量向量的字段
nodes.one_liner_en: The subset of fields deciding stored vectors
nodes.professional_zh: v2 拆分（fingerprints.py:150 起）：embed_id 只收真正决定存量向量取值的字段——backend/model/sha/dim/prompts_doc/pooling/normalization + 媒体预处理串——管「哪些行要重嵌」：files.embed_id ≠ live 才重嵌。两个关键区分：文档提示词进（它变了，每个存量向量的取值就变），查询提示词不进（只影响查询侧算法，零重嵌）；管道级 preprocessing 不进（由提取器版本层负责，重抽自然重嵌）。2026-10 的 v1→v2 提示词重构因此对存量库是零重嵌迁移。
nodes.professional_en: The v2 split (fingerprints.py:150 onward): embed_id keeps only the fields that truly decide stored vector values — backend/model/sha/dim/prompts_doc/pooling/normalization plus the media preprocessing string — and governs 'which rows re-embed': rows re-embed only when files.embed_id ≠ live. Two distinctions matter: the document prompt is in (change it and every stored vector's value changes) while the query prompt is out (it only changes the query-side algorithm — zero re-embeds); pipeline-level preprocessing is out (the extractor-version layer handles it; re-extraction re-embeds anyway). The 2026-10 v1→v2 prompt refactor was thus a zero-re-embed migration for existing libraries.
nodes.plain_zh: 大门（指纹）管「这个库还能不能用」，embed_id 管「哪几排货要重新加工」。改造查询柜台不必返工货架；改造加工车间的工艺，货全得重做。分层之后，「改了 X 会发生什么」变成一道查表题。
nodes.plain_en: The front gate (fingerprint) decides 'can this library still be used'; embed_id decides 'which shelves need reworking'. Redecorate the query counter and the shelves stay; change the workshop's process and every item must be redone. Once layered, 'what happens if I change X' becomes a lookup table.
nodes.example_zh: 2026-10 的 v1→v2 提示词重构：迁移回填的 embed_id 与新库逐位相等（B2 绑定规则写死）——存量一行不重嵌。健康检查：python3 -m goldmine status --db evals/eval.sqlite --json 里 staleness 的 embed_stale 应为 0。
nodes.example_en: The 2026-10 v1→v2 prompt refactor: the backfilled embed_id equals the fresh-library value bit for bit (the B2 binding rule) — not one stored row re-embedded. Health check: in python3 -m goldmine status --db evals/eval.sqlite --json, staleness's embed_stale should be 0.

nodes.one_liner_zh: 版本串不在册就重抽，方向朝安全
nodes.one_liner_en: Unknown version string means re-extract — fail safe
nodes.professional_zh: 每行文件存一个 extractor_version 字符串（如 pdftotext@24.08.0、media-ffmpeg-mm.v3）；current_extractors() 给出本构建可能写出的全部字符串集合，行的版本不在集合里 = stale = 下次摄取重抽。设计方向永远朝安全：注册表漏登新串，后果只是多抽一遍（无害）；反方向（行为变了版本没变）才是灾难——旧行静默过期。登记新行为必须「行为变 → 串变 → 注册」三件套。另有 redo 标记（如 OCR 从不可用变可用）走升级路径，终态后不再触发。
nodes.professional_en: Every row stores an extractor_version string (e.g. pdftotext@24.08.0, media-ffmpeg-mm.v3); current_extractors() yields every string this build could write, and a row whose version isn't in the set is stale → re-extracted next ingest. The design fails safe: a forgotten registration merely re-extracts once (harmless); the reverse — behavior changed but the string didn't — is the disaster, silently stale rows. Registering new behavior takes the triple 'behavior changes → string changes → registry updated'. Separately, redo flags (e.g. OCR became available) handle upgrades and never re-fire after settling.
nodes.plain_zh: 每件货物贴一张「由几号规程加工」的标签，仓库里放一本现行规程总册。标签对不上总册的一律重新加工——宁可白干一遍，不可漏加工一件。踩过的坑：三处手写版本号，总册升了 v3、车间还写 v2，整仓货物永远「对不上」、永远重复加工。
nodes.plain_en: Every item carries a 'processed under rule #x' tag, and the warehouse keeps a master book of current rules. A tag missing from the book means reprocess — better to redo one item than skip one. The pothole hit: version numbers handwritten in three places; the book moved to v3 while the shop floor still wrote v2, so the whole stock was forever 'unmatched' and forever reprocessed.
nodes.example_zh: 字面量漂移事故（2026-10-25 批次 B 评审抓的 D1）：extraction.py 三处硬编码 media-ffmpeg-mm.v2，注册表升 v3 → 每行永久反复重抽；修法 = 单一共享常量 + 相等性测试。组合升级（thin 页 OCR + 阿拉伯页替换）由统一组装函数按字母序拼串、注册表登记全部四种组合。
nodes.example_en: The literal-drift incident (batch B review, finding D1, 2026-10-25): extraction.py hardcoded 'media-ffmpeg-mm.v2' in three places while the registry moved to v3 → every row re-extracted forever; fixed with one shared constant plus an equality test. Combo upgrades (thin-page OCR + Arabic page substitution) are assembled by one function in alphabetical order, with all four combinations registered.

nodes.one_liner_zh: 搜索质量的三把尺子
nodes.one_liner_en: Three rulers for search quality
nodes.professional_zh: s@5 = 前 5 条里有没有正确答案（0/1）；MRR = 正确答案排名的倒数（第 1 名 1.0、第 3 名约 0.33）；nDCG@10 = 前 10 条带位置折扣的综合分。三者互补：s@5 看「捞没捞到」，MRR 看「排多前」，nDCG 看「整个榜单的质量分布」。另有 zero-hit honesty 尺量噪音查询是否正确返回零。
nodes.professional_en: s@5 = whether the top 5 contain a correct answer (0/1); MRR = the reciprocal of the correct answer's rank (rank 1 → 1.0, rank 3 → 0.33); nDCG@10 = a position-discounted composite over the top 10. They complement: s@5 asks 'did we catch it', MRR asks 'how high', nDCG asks 'how well ordered overall'. A fourth ruler, zero-hit honesty, checks that noise queries correctly return nothing.
nodes.plain_zh: 找东西的三种打分法：一、前五个结果里有没有对的（及格/不及格）；二、对的排第几（越靠前越好）；三、整个榜单排得像不像话（好东西越靠前越好）。
nodes.plain_en: Three ways to grade a search: one, was anything correct in the first five (pass/fail); two, where did the right one rank (higher is better); three, does the whole list make sense (good stuff near the top).
nodes.example_zh: z_gate 2.0→3.0 的 A/B 用这些尺记录：s@5 0.747→0.781、MRR 0.646→0.665（n=146 真模型评测）。自己跑回归门：python3 scripts/eval_real.py --suite legacy --backend llama --gate → 结尾 gate: green 且各指标 delta 全 +0.0000。
nodes.example_en: The z_gate 2.0→3.0 A/B was recorded with these rulers: s@5 0.747→0.781, MRR 0.646→0.665 (n=146, real-model eval). Run the gate yourself: python3 scripts/eval_real.py --suite legacy --backend llama --gate → ends with 'gate: green' and every metric delta at +0.0000.

nodes.one_liner_zh: 分清真改进还是运气
nodes.one_liner_en: Telling real improvement from luck
nodes.professional_zh: 判断「新旧分数之差是真改进还是噪声」的统计检验。McNemar 只看一增一失的题（两边都对的题不提供信息）；成对 bootstrap 反复重抽样本算差的置信区间。结论形如「p=1.0 / CI 含 0」= 没证据说是真变化。数学根据：128 题的样本里一题摆动就是 0.8%——不检验就会把噪声当成果，这是「不做质量重试」纪律的来源。
nodes.professional_en: Statistical tests for 'is this score difference real or noise'. McNemar looks only at discordant pairs (questions one side got and the other missed — both-correct items carry no information); paired bootstrap resamples to build a confidence interval for the difference. A verdict like 'p=1.0 / CI contains 0' means no evidence of real change. The math behind it: with 128 questions, one flipped question is 0.8% — without testing, noise gets celebrated as progress. This is where the 'no quality retries' discipline comes from.
nodes.plain_zh: 两个学生考试差 2 分，能说谁更厉害吗？先只看「甲对乙错」和「甲错乙对」的题——两人都对的题不算数。再看班里的正常波动：分差小于波动幅度，就老老实实说「分不出高下」。
nodes.plain_en: Two students differ by 2 points — does that prove who is better? First count only the questions one got right and the other missed; questions both solved prove nothing. Then weigh the class's normal wobble: a gap smaller than the wobble means an honest 'too close to call'.
nodes.example_zh: digup-plan-001 的 A/B 零改善即按预注册判负回滚，而不是「再试试别的参数」。128 题套件上任何 ±0.8% 的摆动都要先过统计检验再谈采纳。
nodes.example_en: digup-plan-001's A/B showing zero improvement was rolled back per preregistration — not 'let's try other knobs'. On the 128-question suite, any ±0.8% wobble passes a statistical test before anyone talks about adopting it.

nodes.one_liner_en: Half the questions sealed until final acceptance
nodes.professional_zh: 题库分两半：train 用来调参，holdout 封存只在最后验收打开。只用 train 调出的「改进」可能只是背题；holdout 是防背题的考卷。本项目 holdout 密封（有 freeze 测试守卫），任何 reports 外的 holdout 路径不碰；校准纪律要求 train 与 holdout 一致才算数。
nodes.professional_en: The question bank splits in half: train for tuning, holdout sealed until final acceptance. An 'improvement' tuned only on train may just be memorization; holdout is the anti-memorization exam. This project's holdout is sealed (guarded by freeze tests), no path outside reports touches it, and calibration requires train and holdout to agree before anything counts.
nodes.plain_zh: 复习题和考试卷分开印。天天对着考试卷练，成绩再高也是背题。平时只许看复习题，考试卷锁在柜子里，最后真刀真枪才算数。
nodes.plain_en: Print practice exams and the final exam separately. Drill on the final itself and any high score is memorization. Practice papers only, the final locked in a cabinet, and the real thing counts once.
nodes.example_zh: z_gate=3.0 的采纳依据之一是「train 和 holdout 一致」；3.5 虽在 train 更好（0.822）但只扫了一次，不敢信。守卫测试：python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_joint_holdout.py tests/test_joint_holdout_freeze.py。

nodes.one_liner_zh: 先冻结设计与判据再动手
nodes.one_liner_en: Freeze the design and criteria before building
nodes.professional_zh: 结构性改动前把设计、逐文件哈希、通过判据冻结成文——先承诺再动手，防止「边做边改标准」。判负就回滚：digup-plan-001 的检索改进在 DigUp 有实测正收益，goldmine 自己 A/B 后零改善，按预注册判负回滚；另一项撞了冻结基线，按规则回滚。DigUp 的数字是先验不是证明——此为铁律。批次 B 的尾窗语义偏差也明写进预注册。
nodes.professional_en: Before any structural change, the design, per-file hashes, and pass criteria are frozen in writing — commit first, build second — so standards can't drift mid-flight. A loss is a rollback: digup-plan-001's retrieval tweaks had measured wins in DigUp, showed zero improvement in goldmine's own A/B, and were rolled back per preregistration; another change hit a frozen baseline and rolled back by rule. DigUp's numbers are a prior, not a proof — iron law. Batch B's tail-window semantic deviation was likewise written into its preregistration.
nodes.plain_zh: 动工前把图纸、验收标准和「什么情况算失败」白纸黑字公证一份，完工时对照公证书说话，不许赛后改标准把失败说成成功。别家工地考了 90 分，不代表你的考场一定行——各考各的。
nodes.plain_en: Notarize the blueprint, the acceptance bar, and the definition of failure before breaking ground; at handover, the notarized paper talks. No post-hoc standard editing to relabel failure as success. Another site scoring 90 proves nothing about your exam — each site takes its own test.

nodes.example_en: Live specimens: reports/execution/digup-plan-001/ and digup-plan-002/ (preregistration plus the rollback, fully on record). The zero-improvement rollback is its landmark precedent — not 'tune it some more'.

nodes.one_liner_zh: 基线重生的唯一合法通道
nodes.one_liner_en: The only legal path to regenerate a baseline
nodes.professional_zh: 基线 = 冻结的历史分数（比较的锚）；gate = 每次 CI 式重跑与基线比、超阈值即红。基线确实需要重生时（语料或身份合法变化）唯一合法通道是审计门：先备份 → 重建 → 逐条对账每处差异（预期内放行、未解释的漂移追责）——杜绝「顺手夹带」。评测基线带 corpus_version + corpus_sha，语料漂移会让 gate 响亮作废，而不是静默拿旧分母比新语料。
nodes.professional_en: A baseline is frozen history (the anchor of comparison); a gate is every CI-style rerun compared against it, red past a threshold. When a baseline legitimately must be reborn (corpus or identity legally changed), the audit gate is the only legal path: back up first → rebuild → account for every difference item by item (expected ones pass, unexplained drift gets chased). 'Rebuild while we're at it' smuggling is what this kills. Eval baselines carry corpus_version + corpus_sha; corpus drift voids the gate loudly rather than silently comparing an old denominator to a new corpus.
nodes.plain_zh: 成绩单锁在保险柜，平时只能对照、不能改。真到了必须重考（比如换了考场），流程是：旧成绩单复印存档 → 重考 → 每一处分差说清来历。说不清的那一分，不许悄悄抹平。
nodes.plain_en: The report card stays locked in a safe — compare against it, never edit it. When a retake is truly required (say, the exam hall changed): photocopy the old card for the archive → retake → explain every point of difference. A point you can't explain doesn't get quietly smoothed over.

nodes.one_liner_zh: 缩放差一位，向量家族就分裂
nodes.one_liner_en: One bit off in scaling splits the vector family
nodes.professional_zh: 图片进模型前要缩放；本项目把 mtmd/Pillow 风格的双三次缩放（a=−0.5，Catmull-Rom）逐位移植，用 22 位定点整数运算规避不同 CPU 浮点实现的末位差异。黄金表测试钉死 helper 与参考实现必须一位不差——缩放差一位 → 向量差一点 → 家族分裂（跨家族比分数，搜索静默变坏）。
nodes.professional_en: Images must be resized before entering the model; this project ports the mtmd/Pillow-style bicubic resize (a=−0.5, Catmull-Rom) bit for bit, using 22-bit fixed-point integer arithmetic to dodge last-digit differences across CPU floating-point implementations. Golden-table tests pin the helper to the reference implementation — one bit off in scaling nudges the vector, and the family splits (cross-family score comparisons silently rot search).
nodes.plain_zh: 冲照片的显影工序必须和老师傅的手法分毫不差——差一点点，整卷照片色调就偏了，而且新旧照片摆在一起你会以为是两台相机拍的。整数运算是关键：小数计算在不同芯片上最后一位可能不同，改成整数就钉死了。
nodes.plain_en: The darkroom process must match the old master's technique to the letter — a hair off and the whole roll shifts tint, and mixing old and new prints you'd swear two different cameras shot them. Integer arithmetic is the trick: decimals can differ in the last digit across chips; integers can't.
nodes.example_zh: goldmine-embed.c 的注释点名取舍：a=−0.5 是 Pillow 的选择（GGML/PyTorch 用 −0.75）——跟错参考实现就是另一个家族。验证：python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_embed_helper_unit.py（resize 黄金表逐位比对）。
nodes.example_en: A comment in goldmine-embed.c names the choice: a=−0.5 follows Pillow (GGML/PyTorch use −0.75) — follow the wrong reference and you are another family. Verify: python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_embed_helper_unit.py (bit-exact golden-table comparison of the resize).

nodes.one_liner_zh: 8×8 点阵指纹，相似帧快速去重
nodes.one_liner_en: 8×8 bit pattern dedupes near-identical frames
nodes.professional_zh: aHash 把帧缩到 8×8 灰度、与平均值比较得 64 个 0/1 位；比较两哈希的「不同位数」（海明距离），≤4 视为同帧。用于视频关键帧去重：每约 3 秒采一帧、至多 1200 帧——静止画面连采 100 帧也只留 1 帧，省下的是每帧 70 token 的嵌入预算。帧提取串（ahash4bit/max1200）进媒体加工指纹。
nodes.professional_en: aHash shrinks a frame to 8×8 grayscale, compares each cell to the average, and yields 64 bits; Hamming distance ≤ 4 counts as the same frame. It dedupes video keyframes: one frame per ~3 seconds, at most 1200 — a static scene sampled 100 times keeps exactly 1, saving 70 tokens of embedding budget per dropped frame. The extraction string (ahash4bit/max1200) lives in the media preprocessing fingerprint.
nodes.plain_zh: 把每张照片缩成八乘八的黑白小格子，像一张「像素指纹卡」。两张卡只有少数几格不同，就是同一个画面。一分钟的静止画面不用留六十张一样的照片，留一张就够。
nodes.plain_en: Shrink each photo to an 8×8 grid of black/white dots — a tiny dot-pattern ID card. Two cards differing in only a few dots are the same picture. A minute of stillness doesn't need sixty identical photos; one will do.
nodes.example_zh: media.py 里帧提取串写明 frames=fps1/3,ahash4bit,jpeg1024,max1200——每秒三分之一帧、aHash 去重、JPEG 1024、至多 1200 帧。静止画面 100 帧采样后只留 1 帧。
nodes.example_en: media.py's extraction string reads 'frames=fps1/3,ahash4bit,jpeg1024,max1200' — a third of a frame per second, aHash dedup, JPEG 1024, max 1200 frames. A static scene sampled 100 times keeps exactly one.

nodes.one_liner_zh: 低于 −50dB 的窗口不值得嵌入
nodes.one_liner_en: Windows below −50 dB are skipped
nodes.professional_zh: 均方根（RMS）≈ 响度代理；低于 0.003（约 −50 dBFS）的音频窗口没有信息，跳过不浪费嵌入。与 30 秒窗、25 秒步进的分窗配合，静音窗直接丢弃；该参数进媒体加工串（rms-gate0.003），是 DigUp 先验。
nodes.professional_en: Root-mean-square approximates loudness; an audio window below 0.003 (about −50 dBFS) carries no information and is skipped rather than embedded. It works alongside 30-second windows with a 25-second hop; the constant enters the media preprocessing string (rms-gate0.003) as a DigUp prior.
nodes.plain_zh: 录音里大段的「没人说话」不用请速记员记：先量一量这一段有多安静，安静到听不见的整段跳过，省时省钱。
nodes.plain_en: Long stretches of nobody talking don't need a stenographer: measure how quiet a stretch is, and skip the ones too quiet to hear — time and money saved.
nodes.example_zh: media.py 的常量：SILENCE_RMS = 0.003（≈ −50 dBFS，DigUp 先验）；v5 加工串片段 window30s,hop25s,rms-gate0.003,tail-min2s。

nodes.one_liner_zh: 尾窗带来新内容才保留
nodes.one_liner_en: Keep the tail only if it adds new audio
nodes.professional_zh: 音频按 30 秒窗、25 秒步进分窗时，最后一个不满 30 秒的尾窗只有在携带 ≥2 秒「超出上一窗覆盖的新音频」时才保留。源码考古发现：goal prompt 写的「丢 <2s 尾窗」在 30/25 参数下字面上不可达（尾窗最短 5 秒），prompt 的 62 秒例子还与源码相反——按源码移植，偏差写进预注册。教训：「prompt 当规格」有风险，流程要求对照源码。
nodes.professional_en: With 30-second windows hopping 25 seconds, the final partial tail window survives only if it carries ≥2 seconds of new audio beyond the previous window's coverage. Source archaeology revealed that the goal prompt's literal 'drop tails <2s' was unreachable dead code under 30/25 (a tail is at least 5 seconds), and its 62-second example contradicted the source — ported per source, deviation recorded in preregistration. Lesson: 'the prompt as spec' is risky; the process demands checking against source.
nodes.plain_zh: 交接班时，下一班只比上一班多听了两分钟以上，才值得把记录本续写一页；只多几秒的重复内容，上一页里已经有了。
nodes.plain_en: At shift handover, the next shift only writes a fresh log page if it heard two more minutes beyond the last shift's coverage; a few seconds of repetition already lives on the previous page.
nodes.example_zh: 30 秒窗、25 秒步进下：62 秒音频 → 窗 [0,30)、[25,55)、尾窗 [50,62) 带 7 秒新音频（超出上一窗覆盖）→ 保留；56 秒音频 → 尾窗 [50,56) 只带 1 秒新音频 → 不保留。而「尾窗长度 <2 秒」在这种参数下根本不可能出现（最短 5 秒）——这正是死代码考古的发现。
nodes.example_en: Under 30s windows / 25s hop: a 62s file → windows [0,30), [25,55), tail [50,62) carrying 7s of new audio (beyond the prior window) → kept; a 56s file → tail [50,56) carrying only 1s new → dropped. Meanwhile 'tail shorter than 2s' literally cannot occur under these parameters (minimum 5s) — exactly the dead-code finding.

Routing rule MM-D3: audio with a transcript uses the text vector; only transcript-less audio falls back to the raw audio vector; every row's info states why that vector exists or not ('raw:no-transcript(asr_status)').
nodes.plain_zh: 先让人指出「从第几秒到第几秒有人在说话」，再请速记员只记这些段——对空白和音乐硬记，他会自己编出话来（这叫幻觉）。
nodes.plain_en: First someone points out 'someone is talking from here to here'; only then does the stenographer take those stretches. Forced to take silence or music, he starts inventing sentences (that's called hallucination).
nodes.example_zh: 转写成功的音频走文字向量（更准）；ASR 不可用时回退音频向量，info 里逐行记 asr_status。验证媒体向量未被改坏：GOLDMINE_LIVE=1 python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_reference_media_vectors.py。

nodes.professional_zh: 光学字符识别把图片/扫描页里的字变成可搜文本。本项目用 macOS 系统 Vision 框架（经 Python helper 调用）做截图/扫描页的 OCR，走批处理：多张截图的请求汇进一个批次，由 _leader 线程一次性 spawn helper，省掉每图一次的进程启动与 Vision 冷启动。OCR 可用性逐页记录（ocr_page_states），从不可用变可用触发 redo 重抽。
nodes.professional_en: Optical character recognition turns text inside images and scanned pages into searchable text. This project uses macOS's system Vision framework (called through a Python helper) for screenshots and scanned pages, batched: many screenshot requests pool into one batch and a _leader thread spawns the helper once, saving per-image process startup and Vision cold starts. Per-page availability is recorded (ocr_page_states); unavailable→available transitions trigger a redo re-extraction.

nodes.professional_zh: 某类 PDF 的阿拉伯语文本层丢 lam-连写字形（lostLetters 病理）：显示与复制都残缺。goldmine 检测该病理并用 OCR 替换文本层。病理复现验证诚实失败：macOS 原生工具链产出的阿拉伯 PDF 全带完整 ToUnicode，造不出病——按预注册回退为合成病理 + 机制测试，真实资产记 MISSING。版本串按组合登记（如 pdftotext+arocr+visionocr@24.08.0，四种组合全部入册）。
nodes.professional_en: Some PDFs' Arabic text layer loses lam-ligature glyphs (the lostLetters pathology): both display and copy come out mangled. goldmine detects the pathology and replaces the text layer via OCR. The pathology-reproduction validation failed honestly: macOS-native toolchains produce Arabic PDFs with complete ToUnicode, so the disease could not be manufactured — per preregistration it fell back to synthetic pathology plus mechanism tests, with real assets recorded MISSING. Version strings register by combination (e.g. pdftotext+arocr+visionocr@24.08.00, all four combinations on the books).

nodes.one_liner_en: Cloud placeholders that download on open
nodes.professional_zh: macOS 的 st_flags 标志位里 SF_DATALESS（0x40000000）=「iCloud 占位，实体在云上」。对这种文件 open() 即触发下载（可能几百 MB、要走网络）。所以拦截必须在一切会 open 的操作（包括格式嗅探）之前，用 lstat 看标志而不打开文件。Python 的 stat 模块不导出 SF_DATALESS，代码显式定义。文件符号链跟到目标后查的是目标的标志——符号链进 iCloud Drive 也拦得住。
nodes.professional_en: Among macOS's st_flags sits SF_DATALESS (0x40000000) = 'iCloud placeholder, body in the cloud'. Opening such a file triggers a download — possibly hundreds of MB over the network. So the interception must precede any open() (format sniffing included), reading flags via lstat without opening. Python's stat module doesn't export SF_DATALESS; the code defines it explicitly. File symlinks are followed and the target's flags checked — symlinks into iCloud Drive get caught too.
nodes.plain_zh: 云盘文件夹里有很多「空盒子」：看一眼标签就知道是什么，但真要打开，就得现场从云端搬货——又慢又费流量。规矩：先看标签，是空盒子就绕着走，绝对不手贱打开。
nodes.plain_en: Cloud folders hold many 'empty boxes': the label tells you what's inside, but opening one triggers a delivery from the cloud — slow and data-hungry. The rule: read the label, and if it's an empty box, walk around it. Never, ever open it.

nodes.professional_zh: goldmine search | head 里 head 拿够就走，goldmine 再写时内核回 EPIPE，默认行为是 SIGPIPE 信号杀死进程。Python 把 SIGPIPE 转成 BrokenPipeError，但要主动接住才能安静退出。深层坑：小输出躺在用户态缓冲区没进管道，执行期不报错，只在解释器退出 flush 时爆（退出码 120）——修法 = 执行期 handler + 退出前主动 flush 探针（师承 DigUp IndexService.swift:331-336 的 EPIPE 纪律）。
nodes.professional_en: In 'goldmine search | head', head leaves once it has enough; goldmine's next write gets EPIPE from the kernel, whose default is death by SIGPIPE. Python converts SIGPIPE into BrokenPipeError, but you must catch it to exit quietly. The deep trap: small output still sits in userspace buffers, nothing errors during execution, and the explosion waits until interpreter-shutdown flush (exit code 120) — the fix is a runtime handler plus a deliberate pre-exit flush probe (inherited from DigUp's IndexService.swift:331-336 EPIPE discipline).
nodes.plain_zh: 你往传送带上放包裹，对面收货的下班了。放的那一刻传送带还转着（东西堆在缓冲区），等你下班前最后一搬才听见「对面早没人了」的警报——这时想体面收工已经晚了。所以收工前主动按一下警报器试试。
nodes.plain_en: You keep loading the conveyor, but the receiver went home. The belt still moves while you load (goods pile in the buffer); only at your own end-of-day move does the alarm sound — 'nobody's there!' — too late for a graceful exit. So press the alarm deliberately before clocking out.

nodes.one_liner_zh: 缓冲预读会饿死 poll，须裸读
nodes.one_liner_en: Buffered reads starve poll; use raw os.read
nodes.professional_zh: poll = 问内核「这个 fd 现在有数据吗」（level-triggered：有就一直报有）。BufferedReader 会预读——把管道里的数据提前搬进自己的内部缓冲，poll 看管道永远空 → 永远不醒（观测过的真事故：ready 行被 BufferedReader 吃掉、poll 饿死、启动超时）。所以边车协议读必须用裸 fd 的 os.read，要多少读多少。
nodes.professional_en: poll asks the kernel 'does this fd have data now' (level-triggered: reports readiness as long as data remains). BufferedReader prefetches — hauling pipe data into its internal buffer ahead of time, so the pipe always looks empty to poll, which never wakes (an observed real incident: the ready line eaten by the BufferedReader, poll starved, startup timed out). Hence the sidecar protocol must read with raw-fd os.read, taking exactly what is needed.
nodes.plain_zh: 你雇了个跑腿的盯着信箱（poll 只认信箱），又让实习生「顺手」把信箱里的信先拿进屋里——跑腿的一直盯着空信箱，永远不报告有信。规矩：要一封，亲手只拿一封。
nodes.plain_en: You hire a runner to watch the mailbox (poll only knows the mailbox), then let an intern 'helpfully' carry the mail indoors — the runner stares at an empty mailbox forever and never reports. The rule: need one letter, personally take exactly one letter.

nodes.one_liner_zh: inode 没变只是搬家，不重嵌
nodes.one_liner_en: Same inode elsewhere means moved, not deleted
nodes.professional_zh: inode = 文件系统里文件的唯一编号，改名、挪目录都不变。删除检测时「路径消失但 POSIX 身份（dev+ino+大小+mtime）出现在本轮候选里」= 移动而非删除——改个路径保住全部已嵌内容，不删不重嵌。配套守卫：根/子树不可读 ≠ 空（弹出硬盘、TCC 弹窗绝不能读成「全删了」），unreachable 前缀守卫保留这些行。
nodes.professional_en: An inode is the filesystem's unique number for a file — renaming or moving directories never changes it. During deletion detection, 'path vanished but its POSIX identity (dev+ino+size+mtime) appears among this round's candidates' means moved, not deleted — update the path and keep every embedded vector, no deletion, no re-embedding. Companion guard: an unreadable root/subtree is not empty (an ejected drive or a TCC dialog must never read as 'user deleted everything'); an unreachable-prefix guard preserves those rows.
nodes.plain_zh: 你把车从车库挪到路边，车牌没变。系统记车牌不记车位——车牌还在城里出现，就知道你是搬家不是卖车，整套保养记录照用。但如果是整个车库大门打不开（硬盘弹出了），绝不能断定车都卖了。
nodes.plain_en: You moved the car from the garage to the curb; the plate didn't change. The system tracks plates, not parking spots — the plate still appears in town, so you moved, you didn't sell, and the whole maintenance record survives. But if the entire garage door won't open (drive ejected), that proves nothing about the cars.

Deliberate restrictions: read-only (creates no index, ingests nothing, touches no client config); get/context accept only gm1:... citations returned by search — never paths, URLs, or SQL; changed citation content returns stale_citation; photo names/metadata are labeled name_metadata, never disguised as image descriptions; deadlines default to fast 5s / quality 10s with cancellation propagated to checkpoints.

nodes.plain_en: A reading-room window for AI assistants: look and read, never write. The window honors only its own call slips (gm1:... citations) — 'grab the third book on that row' doesn't fly. Nobody reaches through the window into the stacks.

nodes.professional_zh: serve（opt-in）：常驻后端 + 心跳 socket + linger 超时自动退；搜索从「每次起模型几秒」变「亚秒」；能力/指纹信息由静态探针合并——不起进程也能如实回答 visual_search。watch（opt-in）：FSEvents 文件事件 → 静默窗口合并 → 增量摄取（只重做变化的文件）；full_period_s 21600（6 小时）全量兜底扫；毒文件清单（delta 期反复失败的不再无限重试，全量扫时另计）；电源门控（电池模式不起后端）；后端起不来不崩、记录原因、下次再试。
nodes.professional_en: serve (opt-in): a resident backend plus heartbeat socket plus linger timeout auto-exit; search drops from 'spawn the model for seconds each time' to sub-second; capability/fingerprint info merges from static probes — visual_search is answered truthfully without spawning anything. watch (opt-in): FSEvents → quiet-window merging → incremental ingest (only changed files redone); a full_period_s of 21600 (6 hours) as the full-scan fallback; a poison-file list (repeated delta failures stop retrying; the full scan counts separately); power gating (no backend on battery); a backend that fails to start doesn't crash — reason recorded, retry next time.

nodes.one_liner_zh: 只有三种结论，禁说基本通过
nodes.one_liner_en: PASS, FAIL, or MISSING — nothing in between
nodes.professional_zh: 记录层的证据纪律：PASS 必须带原始回执（命令行、退出码、输出哈希、前后源码身份）；FAIL 如实记；证据不可得记 MISSING。「基本通过」是禁语。动机：开发主力是 AI 会话，AI 的失败模式是「自信地编」——三态让「编」在流程里活不过验证关。
nodes.professional_en: The evidence discipline for records: PASS must carry the original receipt (command line, exit code, output hash, before/after source identity); FAIL is recorded as it happened; unobtainable evidence is MISSING. 'Basically passed' is banned vocabulary. Rationale: the workforce is AI sessions, whose failure mode is confident fabrication — three states make fabrication unable to survive verification.
nodes.plain_zh: 施工验收只有三种盖章：合格（附验收单原件）、不合格、没验成（附原因）。没有「差不多合格」这种章——章一模糊，下次就有人拿它当合格用。
nodes.plain_en: Construction sign-off has exactly three stamps: passed (with the original inspection sheet), failed, not-inspected (with the reason). There is no 'basically passed' stamp — once a stamp blurs, someone will use it as passed.
nodes.example_zh: MISSING 的活例：阿拉伯病理复现——真实资产记 MISSING，用合成病理 + 机制测试顶上。PASS 的活例：docs/ANCHORS.md 六条命令每条都实跑过并附「怎么读输出」。

nodes.one_liner_zh: 宁可少说，不可说谎
nodes.one_liner_en: Understate rather than lie
nodes.professional_zh: 横切全部模块的设计纪律：宁可少说不可说谎，宁可报 UNKNOWN 不可装知道。七条正文：能力行不说谎；零命中是合法答案（exit 0）；指纹不符拒绝服务（exit 3）；降级必须大声（estimate 缺 pdfinfo 时明说「按 10 页/PDF 估的」）；不可读 ≠ 空；部分失败是记账不是灾难（exit 5）；证据三态。收益是信任可以局部重建——任何一行输出都能沿明示链路查到底。每条静默降级比诚实降级省二十行代码，省到最后没人知道系统什么时候在瞎说。
nodes.professional_en: A design discipline cutting across every module: understate rather than lie; report UNKNOWN rather than bluff. Seven clauses: capability rows never lie; zero hits is a legal answer (exit 0); fingerprint mismatch refuses service (exit 3); degradation must be loud (estimate without pdfinfo says 'assumed 10 pages/PDF'); unreadable ≠ empty; partial failure is bookkeeping, not disaster (exit 5); three-state evidence. The payoff: trust can be rebuilt locally — every output line traces down an explicit chain. Each silent degradation saves twenty lines over an honest one; save enough and nobody knows when the system is bluffing.
nodes.plain_zh: 店里没有的货就说没有，绝不拿别的凑；暂时不知道就说不知道。这样客人随时可以抽查任何一句话——查得动，才信得过。
nodes.plain_en: If the shop doesn't stock it, say so — never substitute something similar; if you don't know yet, say you don't know. Customers can spot-check any sentence you say; checkable is believable.

nodes.one_liner_zh: 没找到就说没找到，退出码 0
nodes.one_liner_en: Nothing found is a valid answer, exit 0
nodes.professional_zh: 零命中打印 nothing found + 一条下一步建议，退出码 0，永不硬凑。噪音查询（乱打的词）的正确答案就是零——评测里有专门的 zero-hit honesty 指标（当前 1.0；n=5，属 advisory 指标，只如实报告不触发门）。z_gate 2.0→3.0 把零命中诚实度从 0.4 提到 0.6：更严的门槛等于更少硬凑。
nodes.professional_en: Zero hits prints 'nothing found' plus one next-step suggestion and exits 0 — never padded. For noise queries (keyboard mashing), zero IS the correct answer; the eval suite carries a dedicated zero-hit honesty metric (currently 1.0; n=5, advisory — reported verbatim, never trips the gate). Raising z_gate 2.0→3.0 lifted zero-hit honesty 0.4→0.6: a stricter gate means less padding.
nodes.plain_zh: 药店没这种药就直接说「没有」，而不是抓一把相似的药给你。问一个乱七八糟的词，正确答案就是「查无此物」。
nodes.plain_en: A pharmacy that doesn't stock it says 'we don't have it' — it doesn't hand you a handful of lookalikes. Ask a nonsense word and the right answer is 'nothing matches'.
nodes.example_zh: 现场看零命中输出：python3 -m goldmine search zzqxjv --db evals/eval.sqlite → nothing found + 建议，rc=0。评测里 zero-hit honesty 在 ADVISORY_METRICS 名单（scripts/eval_public.py），n=5、如实上报。
nodes.example_en: See it live: python3 -m goldmine search zzqxjv --db evals/eval.sqlite → 'nothing found' plus a suggestion, rc=0. In evals, zero-hit honesty sits on the ADVISORY_METRICS list (scripts/eval_public.py), n=5, reported verbatim.

nodes.one_liner_zh: 每个文件四选一，没有差不多
nodes.one_liner_en: Every file gets one of four honest labels
nodes.professional_zh: 每个文件的能力行四选一：content_indexed（真读真嵌）/ metadata_only（只有名字可搜，原因写明：OCR 缺、ffmpeg 缺、后端无图嵌入）/ unsupported（刻意不读：密钥、许可、构建目录——带原因）/ failed（试了没成——带原因）。没有「差不多算读过了」这一栏。metadata_only 的行仍可被搜到——靠文件名进 FTS。visual_search 这类能力布尔由静态探针派生（helper+mmproj 能解析才 true），不许配置写死。
nodes.professional_en: Every file's capability row is one of four: content_indexed (truly read and embedded), metadata_only (only the name is searchable, reason stated: OCR missing, ffmpeg missing, backend can't embed images), unsupported (deliberately unread: secrets, licenses, build dirs — reason stated), failed (tried and didn't make it — reason stated). There is no 'roughly read' column. metadata_only rows remain findable via filename in FTS. Capability booleans like visual_search derive from static probes (true only when helper+mmproj resolve) — never hardcoded config.
nodes.plain_zh: 每份档案贴一张四选一的标签：全读了 / 只看了封面（为什么只看封面要写明）/ 故意不读（涉密）/ 读了没读成。不许贴「大概齐读过了」。
nodes.plain_en: Every folder gets one of four labels: fully read / cover only (why cover-only must be written down) / deliberately skipped (classified) / tried and failed. 'More or less read' is not a label.
nodes.example_zh: goldmine status --failures 逐行给你看谁失败、为什么（exit 5 的记账出口）。评测库现状抽查：python3 -m goldmine status --db evals/eval.sqlite --json 的 capability 分布与 staleness 四计数（应全 0）。
nodes.example_en: 'goldmine status --failures' lists each failing file and why (the exit-5 bookkeeping outlet). Spot-check the eval library: python3 -m goldmine status --db evals/eval.sqlite --json shows capability distribution and the four staleness counts (all should be 0).

nodes.one_liner_zh: 0 到 130，每个数字一个故事
nodes.one_liner_en: Zero to 130: every number tells a story
nodes.professional_zh: 0 全成或诚实零；1 运行时错；2 用法错/后端起不来；3 指纹拒；4 前置缺失（没索引/没装 MCP extra）；5 部分失败（有按文件的失败行，原因在能力行里）；130 Ctrl-C。部分失败不是灾难是记账——重跑续传。退出码与 --json、MCP 的错误面共用同一套语义。
nodes.professional_en: 0 = all fine or an honest zero; 1 runtime error; 2 usage error / backend failed to start; 3 fingerprint refusal; 4 missing prerequisite (no index / MCP extra not installed); 5 partial failure (per-file failure rows, reasons in capability rows); 130 Ctrl-C. Partial failure is bookkeeping, not disaster — rerun resumes. The same semantics are shared by --json and the MCP error surface.
nodes.plain_zh: 出门留字条：「办完了」「没找着」「钥匙丢了」——每张字条有固定编号，看编号就知道发生了什么，不用翻日志猜。
nodes.plain_en: Leave a note when heading out: 'done', 'not found', 'lost the keys' — each note has a fixed number; read the number, know what happened, no log-digging.
nodes.example_zh: 现场对照：python3 -m goldmine search "copper gasket" --db evals/eval.sqlite.pre-p2b.sqlite; echo rc=$? → rc=3（指纹拒）；加 --lexical → rc=0。exit 5 后接 goldmine status --failures 看逐行原因；Ctrl-C 中断 → rc=130，重跑靠内容哈希续传。
nodes.example_en: See them side by side: python3 -m goldmine search "copper gasket" --db evals/eval.sqlite.pre-p2b.sqlite; echo rc=$? → rc=3 (fingerprint refusal); add --lexical → rc=0. After exit 5, 'goldmine status --failures' shows per-file reasons; a Ctrl-C interrupt gives rc=130, and rerun resumes via content hashes.

nodes.one_liner_zh: 每个 AI 会话独立分支，合并经用户
nodes.one_liner_en: Each AI session works on its own branch
nodes.professional_zh: 制度化为 AGENTS.md 铁律：每个 AI 会话在独立分支干活，合并经用户。起源是撞车事件：最终全量测试突然冒出陌生失败，排查发现另一个 AI 会话在同一工作树并行干活——27 个评测文件被改成占位符路径。处理：把对方的 27 个文件 stash 出去 → 失败全恢复绿（归因成立）→ 白名单提交自己的文件（一行不吞）→ stash 由对方自己消费。教训同时衍生出 flaky 处置纪律：单独重跑 3 次；怀疑新改动时用 stash A/B 归因，比「重跑到绿」诚实。
nodes.professional_en: Codified as an AGENTS.md iron law: every AI session works on its own branch, merges go through the user. It was born in a collision: the full test run suddenly grew strange failures; investigation found another AI session working the same tree in parallel — 27 eval files rewritten to placeholder paths. Resolution: stash the other session's 27 files → all failures turned green (attribution confirmed) → whitelist-commit only one's own files (not one line of the other's) → the stash consumed by its owner. It also spawned the flaky-test discipline: rerun alone 3 times; suspect your own change and attribute it with a stash A/B — more honest than 'rerun until green'.
nodes.plain_zh: 两位装修师傅不能同时在同一面墙上干活——刷的刷、凿的凿，谁也不知道墙面最后什么样。各干各的墙（分支），完工后由房东验收合并。出了问题先把对方的工具搬走再验：墙好了，就是他的责任；还坏，才是我的。
nodes.plain_en: Two painters can't work the same wall at once — one brushing, one chiseling, nobody knows what the wall ends up as. Each takes a wall (a branch); the landlord inspects and merges. When something breaks, first move the other painter's tools aside and re-check: wall fine → their doing; still broken → mine.
nodes.example_zh: 归因实验流程：git stash 掉对方改动 → 重跑失败测试 → 全绿即归因成立。今天的翻版：全量测试见陌生失败时，拿着测试名去问会话要归因（docs/ANCHORS.md 第 6 条）；resource_observer_native 是已知的时序 flake——单独重跑 3 次再下结论。
nodes.example_en: The attribution drill: git stash the other session's changes → rerun the failing tests → all green means attribution confirmed. Today's version: on strange failures in the full suite, take the test name and demand attribution (docs/ANCHORS.md card 6); resource_observer_native is a known timing flake — rerun it alone 3 times before concluding anything.
